description: Measurement units and stage and category scales for university KPIs, seeded by `npm run seed:scales`. Only missing rows are created, matched by name, so anything edited later stays as edited. Scale scoring starts unapproved: approve it in KPI Management after checking the scores.

measurementUnits.name: Person
measurementUnits.description: People, such as staff or participants

measurementUnits.name: Hour
measurementUnits.description: Time spent, such as training or service hours

measurementUnits.name: Day
measurementUnits.description: Durations, such as days to process a request

measurementUnits.name: Square metre
measurementUnits.description: Areas, such as buildings or farmland

levels.name: Not started
levels.assessmentCriteria: No approved plan or budget yet

levels.name: In progress
levels.assessmentCriteria: Work started and at least a quarter of the activities done

levels.name: Nearly complete
levels.assessmentCriteria: At least three quarters of the activities done

levels.name: Completed
levels.assessmentCriteria: All activities done and handed over

levels.name: Applied
levels.assessmentCriteria: Application submitted to the accrediting body

levels.name: Partly digital
levels.assessmentCriteria: Some steps use computers, records are kept digitally

levels.name: Fully digital
levels.assessmentCriteria: The whole service runs in a system

levels.name: Integrated
levels.assessmentCriteria: The system shares data with other university systems

levels.name: Optimized
levels.assessmentCriteria: Data from the system is used to improve the service
